segments.t: Then after a period of fourteen years
segments.note: διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν を「after a period of fourteen years」とほぐす

segments.t: I went up again to Jerusalem
with Barnabas,
taking Titus also with me.
segments.note: 「with me」は συμ-（共に）の接頭辞

segments.t: I went up by revelation,
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: and I laid before them the Good News
which I preach among the Gentiles,
but privately before those who were respected,
segments.note: 「before」は英語の補い

segments.t: for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
segments.note: μή を「for fear that」とほぐす

segments.t: But not even Titus,
who was with me, being a Greek,
was compelled to be circumcised.
This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in,
segments.note: 「This was」は英語の補い。παρεισάκτους を「secretly brought in」とほぐす

segments.t: who stole in
to spy out our liberty
which we have in Christ Jesus,
that they might bring us into bondage,
to whom we gave no place
in the way of subjection, not for an hour,
that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever
they were, it makes no difference to me;
God doesn’t show partiality to man—they,
segments.note: πρόσωπον … λαμβάνει を「show partiality to man」とほぐす。「they,」は23語目に含まれる

segments.t: I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
segments.note: 「I say」は英語の補い

segments.t: but to the contrary,
when they saw that I had been entrusted
with the Good News for the uncircumcised,
even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
segments.note: 後半の「with the Good News」は εὐαγγέλιον の繰り返し（英語の補い）

segments.t: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised
also worked through me with the Gentiles—
and when they perceived the grace that was given to me,
James and Cephas and John,
those who were reputed to be pillars,
gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（δεξιὰς ἔδωκαν ἐμοὶ καὶ Βαρναβᾷ κοινωνίας）

segments.t: that we should go to the Gentiles,
and they to the circumcision.
They only asked us to remember the poor—which
segments.note: 「They asked us」は英語の補い（ギリシャ語は ἵνα 節のみ）。ὃ は次セグメント側

segments.t: very thing I was also zealous to do.
segments.note: ὃ は8語目「poor—which」に含まれる

segments.t: But when Peter came to Antioch,
segments.note: Κηφᾶς を WEB は「Peter」と訳す

segments.t: I resisted him to his face,
because he stood condemned.
For before some people came from James,
he ate with the Gentiles.
But when they came,
he drew back and separated himself,
fearing those who were of the circumcision.
And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy,
segments.note: 「in his hypocrisy」は συνυπεκρίθησαν のほぐし

segments.t: so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
But when I saw
that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News,
I said to Peter before them all,
segments.note: Κηφᾷ を WEB は「Peter」と訳す

segments.t: “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do,
and not as the Jews do,
segments.note: Ἰουδαϊκῶς（副詞）を「as the Jews do」とほぐす

segments.t: why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
segments.note: Ἰουδαΐζειν を「to live as the Jews do」とほぐす

segments.t: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,
yet knowing that
a man is not justified by the works of the law
but through faith in Jesus Christ,
segments.note: Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ（属格）を WEB は「faith in Jesus Christ」と訳す

segments.t: even we believed in Christ Jesus,
that we might be justified by faith in Christ
and not by the works of the law,
because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
segments.note: πᾶσα σάρξ を「no flesh」とほぐす（否定の組み替え）

segments.t: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners,
is Christ a servant of sin?
Certainly not!
For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
For I through the law died to the law,
that I might live to God.
segments.note: Χριστῷ συνεσταύρωμαι（10–11番）は英語圏の節立てで20節冒頭に置かれるため、ここでは対応なし

segments.t: I have been crucified with Christ,
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文では19節末尾（Χριστῷ συνεσταύρωμαι）。英語圏の節立てで20節に置かれている

segments.t: and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me.
segments.note: ζῶ δὲ οὐκέτι ἐγώ／ζῇ δὲ ἐν ἐμοὶ Χριστός を WEB は対比文に組み替える

segments.t: That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God,
who loved me and gave himself up for me.
I don’t reject the grace of God.
For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
